directAnswer: To check if your VPN is working, visit a website like 'whatismyip.com' to verify your IP address. If the IP address shown is different from your actual IP, your VPN is functioning properly.
summary: This guide provides steps to verify the functionality of your VPN across different platforms.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: Follow the steps below based on your operating system to check your VPN connection.

sections.heading: Common Issues
sections.body: If your VPN is not working, consider checking your internet connection, VPN settings, or contacting your VPN provider.

steps.title: Windows
steps.detail: 1. Connect to your VPN. 2. Open a web browser and go to 'whatismyip.com'. 3. Compare the displayed IP address with your actual IP (search 'what is my IP' in a new tab).

steps.title: macOS
steps.detail: 1. Connect to your VPN. 2. Open Safari or any browser and visit 'whatismyip.com'. 3. Check if the IP address differs from your actual IP.

steps.title: iOS
steps.detail: 1. Enable your VPN from the settings. 2. Open Safari and go to 'whatismyip.com'. 3. Confirm the IP address is different.

steps.title: Android
steps.detail: 1. Connect to your VPN using the app. 2. Open a browser and navigate to 'whatismyip.com'. 3. Ensure the IP address shown is not your real IP.

faqs.question: What should I do if my IP address hasn't changed?
faqs.answer: Ensure your VPN is connected properly, check your settings, or try reconnecting to the VPN.

faqs.question: Can I check my VPN on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can check your VPN connection on both iOS and Android devices using the same method.

faqs.question: What if I see a different IP but still have issues?
faqs.answer: You may be connected to the VPN, but there could be issues with the VPN service itself. Try troubleshooting or contact support.

caveats: Some websites may still detect your actual location due to browser settings or WebRTC leaks.
VPN performance can vary based on server load and location.
